title: Tears of Steel
credit: Tears of Steel, (c) copyright 2012 Blender Foundation, mango.blender.org, CC BY 3.0
premise: In a ruined future Amsterdam, a small team of soldiers and scientists tries to stop an army of robots, with a plan that goes back to one day on a canal bridge.

notes.text: A blinding blast of light rises over a huge industrial plant with tall chimneys.
On a bridge over a canal in Amsterdam, a young woman and a young man are breaking up. She says: You're a jerk, Thom.
Thom says they have to follow their passions: Celia has her robotics, and he just wants to be awesome in space.
Celia, who has a robotic hand, asks if he is just freaked out by it. Thom admits he has nightmares about giant robotic claws.
Celia says: Whatever, Thom. We're done. The words Forty years later appear over a ruined, glowing city.
In a lab full of glowing screens, a scientist in glasses calls out: Robot's memory synced and locked!
A big man with a mechanical eyepiece studies a brain on his desk and says: This is pretty freaky.
Fog hangs over the ruined rooftops of Amsterdam, with huge machines looming in the distance.
High in a church tower, a soldier aims a sniper rifle and watches a flying machine through his scope.
A grey-haired old man sits in the tower near the soldier.
The soldier asks the old man: Shouldn't you be down there?
Someone says: I heard you guys talking last night. It's not my fault, you know.
The old man stands in the ruins of a church, next to a hanging rope.
In a hideout full of maps and lamps, a young woman in a soldier's jacket waits.
The big man with the mechanical eyepiece puts his arm around the old man: Are you ready? Of course you're ready, you're a rockstar.
Someone asks: How's it looking, Barley? The answer: they should have about ten minutes.
The team rushes into action: We're on in one! All systems go! In the lab, scientists work fast.
A giant robot towers over a canal street.
The big man calls the old man Thom. The old man is Thom, forty years older.
The big man tells Thom: There she is. You love her. She is your passion. Be tender to her. Remind her what love is.
A young man who looks just like Thom forty years ago walks onto the canal bridge again.
A voice calls: and, action! The lab announces: Memory overwrite in progress!
The breakup on the bridge plays again, word for word: You're a jerk, Thom!
Thom repeats his old lines while glowing pink words float over the canal.
The team warns: Two minutes left! Speed it up, Thom!
Thom tries new words: he tells Celia he was young and behaved badly, but that's no reason to destroy the world.
It goes wrong: We already tried that one! Abort! Cut! A giant robotic hand grabs Thom.
The giant robot speaks with Celia's voice: You broke my heart. You forgot me on Earth. I should just crush you.
Thom says: I'm sorry. Someone in the team whispers: Good ad-lib.
Someone says: Not my fault! This time. Then: Quiet on set! We're out of time!
In a robot factory, scientists in white suits work among robot parts, and flames burst out.
In the church tower the soldier fights the robots, swinging on a rope and roaring.
The lab reports: Memory overwrite, ninety percent. Someone shouts: Captain! We have to abort!
On the bridge, Thom faces the giant robot and says: The world's changed, Celia. Maybe we can too.
The lab calls out: Memory overwrite complete!
Old Thom stands face to face with a robot among the ruins.
The big man with the eyepiece leans back and says: You know, there's a lesson to be learned from this. Could have gone worse.
The robots lie still among the ruins. The story is over and the credits begin.
After the credits, the soldier sits on a pile of broken robots.

quiz.question: Where do Celia and Thom break up?
quiz.explanation: They break up on a bridge over a canal in Amsterdam.

quiz.question: What does Celia have?
quiz.explanation: Celia has a robotic hand, and Thom admits it freaks him out.

quiz.question: Where does the soldier hide with his rifle?
quiz.explanation: He watches the city from high in a church tower.

quiz.question: Who is the old man?
quiz.explanation: The big man calls him Thom: he is Thom, forty years older.

quiz.question: What does the team overwrite?
quiz.explanation: They replay the breakup on the bridge to overwrite a robot's memory.

chapters.title: The breakup
chapters.summary: On a bridge in Amsterdam, Celia and Thom break up: she loves robotics, he dreams of space.

chapters.title: Forty years later
chapters.summary: Amsterdam lies in ruins. A lab, a man with a robot eye, and a soldier with a sniper rifle in a church tower.

chapters.title: The team
chapters.summary: A team gets ready in their hideout, and the old man turns out to be Thom, forty years older.

chapters.title: Action!
chapters.summary: They replay the breakup on the bridge with a young Thom, to overwrite a robot's memory. Time is running out.

chapters.title: Plan B
chapters.summary: Thom tries new words, it goes wrong, and the giant robot speaks with Celia's voice.

chapters.title: The world's changed
chapters.summary: The soldier fights the robots, Thom tells Celia the world has changed, and the memory overwrite completes.

facts.text: A young man on a canal bridge who dreams of going to space.
Forty years later, he is the old man in the team.
A young woman with a robotic hand, who loves robotics.
Her memories live on in the giant robot.
A scientist in glasses who works the glowing screens in the lab.

characters.name: The man with the robot eye

facts.text: A big man with a mechanical eyepiece, who studies a robot's brain.
He leads the team and cheers the old man on.
A soldier with a sniper rifle, watching the city from a church tower.
A grey-haired old man in the church tower with the soldier.
The others call him Thom: he is Thom, forty years older.
A giant robot towering over a canal street.
It speaks with Celia's voice and memories.
